abbrev ALaCarte.FunctorSizeOf.binaryL29–31 ↗#

public abbrev ALaCarte.FunctorSizeOf.binary {F : Type → Type} (f0 f1 : {a : Type} → F a → a) : ALaCarte.FunctorSizeOf F where sizeOf x := SizeOf.sizeOf (f0 x) + SizeOf.sizeOf (f1 x)

abbrev ALaCarte.FunctorSizeOf.ternaryL33–35 ↗#

public abbrev ALaCarte.FunctorSizeOf.ternary {F : Type → Type} (f0 f1 f2 : {a : Type} → F a → a) : ALaCarte.FunctorSizeOf F where sizeOf x := SizeOf.sizeOf (f0 x) + SizeOf.sizeOf (f1 x) + SizeOf.sizeOf (f2 x)
